summary: Apocrypha now has a measured local living runtime, an owner-gated conversation and memory surface, bounded causal interoception, and a held migration package while the compiled native core is built and proven.
objective: Keep Apocrypha useful, local, private, evidence-linked, and quietly alive between prompts while every external effect remains governed.
principles: Local operation remains useful when network access is removed.
Memory, claims, and actions retain source and authority boundaries.
Unavailable capabilities remain visibly degraded instead of simulated.
Public distribution waits for integrity, signature, install, rollback, and privacy proof.

milestones.label: Personal Brain
milestones.summary: Owner-private conversation, source-linked memory exploration, and the local living runtime have passed focused checks; the website route is promoted only after direct production observation.

milestones.label: Humanity source admission
milestones.summary: A digest-bound admission gate separates reputation, factual trust, and human value while quarantining testimony and rejecting prohibited material.

milestones.label: Causal interoception and recovery
milestones.summary: Redacted causal traces, stable errors, stage latency fields, differential backups, and restore verification are implemented in the compatibility runtime.

milestones.label: CSL, NIL, and CSSL native core
milestones.summary: CSLv3 defines the contract, NIL defines the ordered timing graph, and CSSLv3 is the compiled target; Python remains a sealed rollback until parity and latency gates pass.

milestones.label: Signed local distribution
milestones.summary: A reversible Windows migration package exists and passed focused checks, but remains withheld pending native cryptographic signing, SBOM, and clean-machine lifecycle proof.

release_boundary: This plan is a public-safe projection of active work. It is not a deployment receipt, acceptance result, or release announcement.
